* Given a request and cached response, this figures out whether to use the * network, the cache, or both. * *

Selecting a cache strategy may add conditions to the request (like the * "If-Modified-Since" header for conditional GETs) or warnings to the cached * response (if the cached data is potentially stale). * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: networkRequest
variables.comment: The request to send on the network, or null if this call doesn't use the network.

variables.name: cacheResponse
variables.comment: The cached response to return or validate; or null if this call doesn't use a cache.

methods.name: public static boolean isCacheable(Response response, Request request)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if {@code response} can be stored to later serve another
   * request.

methodNames: public static boolean isCacheable(Response response, Request request)
